data.name: Ruhan
data.gender_notes: Ruhan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A compassionate and merciful name, inspired by the Arabic word for 'compassion'. The name Ruhan carries the meaning “Compassionate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ruhan usually hope their child will grow to embody compassionate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The Quranic verse 2:260 describes the Prophet Muhammad as 'Ruhan' (the Merciful).
data.etymology: Ruhan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Compassionate.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ruhan total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: روحان
in_arabic.long_meaning: روحان هو اسم يعكس الروح والشخصية القوية، مشتق من الجذر العربي ر و ح، والذي يعني الروح أو النفس، ويتحدث القرآن الكريم عن أهمية الروح في تشكيل الشخصية الإنسانية، ولهذا فإن الاسم روحان يعتبر ذا أهمية كبيرة في الثقافة الإسلامية

in_urdu.name: روحان
in_urdu.long_meaning: روحان کا نام عربی gốc سے لیا گیا ہے جو روح یا نفس کو ظاہر کرتا ہے، اور اسلامی روایت میں یہ نام شخصیت کی تشکیل میں روح کی اہمیت کو بیان کرتا ہے، اس لیے روحان کا نام اسلامی ثقافت میں بہت اہم ہے

in_hindi.name: रुहान
in_hindi.long_meaning: रुहान नाम अरबी मूल से लिया गया है जो आत्मा या मन को दर्शाता है, और इस्लामी परंपरा में यह नाम व्यक्तित्व के गठन में आत्मा के महत्व को बताता है, इसलिए रुहान का नाम इस्लामी संस्कृति में बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है

in_pashto.name: روحان
in_pashto.long_meaning: روحان نوم د عربی ریښو څخه اخیستل شوی دی چې روح یا نفس څرګندوي، او په افغان/پشتو دود کې دا نوم د شخصیت د جوړښت په اړه د روح مهمتیا بیانوي، نو ځکه روحان نوم په اسلامي کلتور کې ډیر مهم دی

in_english.name: Ruhan
in_english.long_meaning: Ruhan is a name derived from Arabic roots, signifying soul or spirit, and in Islamic tradition, it emphasizes the importance of the soul in shaping human personality, thus Ruhan is a significant name in Islamic culture, symbolizing spiritual strength and character

pronunciation.hindi: रुहान का उच्चारण रु + हान है
pronunciation.pashto: روحان د تلفظ روح + ان دی

data.cultural_impact: The name "Ruhan" in Arabic language stands for 'compassion'. In Islamic culture, compassion and mercy are considered essential values that shape an individual's character and behavior towards others. In Islamic philosophy, Ruhan can be interpreted as a reminder of Allah's merciful nature towards His creation, inspiring people to show similar compassion towards one another.
data.spiritual_significance: For believers in Islam, the name "Ruhan" carries a deep spiritual significance rooted in the Islamic belief in Allah's infinite mercy and compassion towards all His creations. The name can serve as a constant reminder to the person bearing it to emulate Allah's compassionate nature and to treat everyone with kindness, empathy, and understanding. The name "Ruhan" is thus a beautiful manifestation of the Divine attributes of mercy and compassion present in every individual and can inspire them to live a life marked by love, compassion, and kindness towards all creation.
